start.speaker: system
start.text: ENGINEERING GRID — DRIVE CORE RING. Guest session. Coolant pressure: CRITICAL. Deck grid: FAULT (south arc).

choices.text: Read the WARDEN system architecture file.
Isolate the faulty deck plate grid.
Overload the deck plating under the WARDEN Sentinel's post.

success_effects.reason: Turned the deck grid on the Sentinel

schem.speaker: system
schem.text: Schematic downloaded: engineering ring, workshop, maintenance duct to the archive hold.

spec.speaker: system
spec.text: WARDEN: integrated defense lattice. Cognitive root: CUSTODIAN TEMPLATE (classified).

spec_tav.speaker: tav7
spec_tav.text: Its root is a person's pattern. A human operator's judgment, grown into a defense network. That would explain why its voice feels like someone and not something.

pumps.speaker: system
pumps.text: NORTH PUMP: SEAL FAILURE. SOUTH PUMP: SEAL FAILURE. Seal template SL-4 is loaded at the workshop bench (fabricate: 2 technical components).

plates_ok.speaker: system
plates_ok.text: SOUTH ARC GRID: ISOLATED. The sparking along the deck dies away.

plates_fail.speaker: system
plates_fail.text: GRID CONTROL REJECTED. The plates are still live; the junction box in the south arc can isolate them by hand.

overload_ok.speaker: system
overload_ok.text: EAST ARC DECK: POWER SURGE. Somewhere around the curve of the ring, metal screams and something heavy falls over.
